recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant mustard-yellow field featuring a central horizontal diamond-shaped photographic window, topped by heavy, rounded display typography in contrasting green and orange-red tones.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between the yellow background and the green/red text
Geometric framing of a naturalistic photograph within a rounded diamond shape
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balanced by the central visual anchor
Juxtaposition of organic script lettering with rigid geometric framing
coreInvariants: Three-color palette for text: Forest Green, Burnt Orange, and White

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is contained within a large diamond frame occupying the lower two-thirds of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, green bubble-script title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold green title, moves down to the red subtitle, and settles into the central diamond photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid yellow space surrounding the central elements, creating a clean, retro-pop feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow background providing high energy and vintage warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest green for the primary title, creating a classic 60s complementary feel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange-red for the secondary text line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all colors with flat, matte values; no gradients.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, rounded sans-serif and casual script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a thick, upright script with rounded terminals and tight kerning.
Secondary title uses a heavy, wide slab-serif or rounded-block style.
Metadata uses a clean, wide sans-serif in all caps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a fluid, circular loop.
Lower case 'e' and 'a' in the main title have very small counters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script over blocky slab-serif for rhythmic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tight, organic script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid mustard-yellow square canvas. In the center, place a horizontal diamond shape with rounded corners. Inside the diamond, place a photograph of a group of people in suits standing in a park with trees in the background. The photo should have a slightly desaturated, vintage 1960s film look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large two-line title in a heavy green rounded script at the top. Below it, add a single line of text in a heavy burnt-orange slab-serif font. In the top right corner, add a small white pill-shaped box containing technical metadata in a clean sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat mustard yellow?
Is the central image contained within a rounded diamond?
Is the primary text a heavy green script?
Is the secondary text a bold orange-red?
Is the overall layout centered and balanced?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the diamond frame edges.
Verify the ampersand style matches the script weight.
Check that the yellow is warm and saturated, not neon.
Confirm the diamond shape is horizontally oriented.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color background + Rounded Diamond Photo Mask + Heavy Rounded Script Title + Bold Slab Subtitle = 1960s Pop/Soul Aesthetic.
